character_sheet: A hostile armoured bug that spits acid: a fifteen-plate abdomen on a three-piece hip hub, four legs of a three-piece coxa, a root, four femur plates, a tibia and two tarsus plates each, an upper jaw of a base and three plates with five teeth, a twelve-plate lower jaw, two four-piece palps and two eyes (SpitBugModel.java:212-681, 93 parts), drawn at x0.75. 100 HP, 10 damage, 12 armour, speed 0.33 (EntitySpitBug.java:97-105). On a 1-in-5 tick it picks prey in a 12-block box - anything living but the ender reaper and knight, endermen, the hydrolisc, creepers, its own kind, trooper bugs and creative players (:212-223, :235-248, :274-303); it closes at 0.5 and, within 3 blocks plus half the target's width, rolls its bite on a 1-in-5 cadence for 10 with a knockback (:86, :158-175; BugMeleeAttackGoal.Params.spitBug; BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:159-174); out of reach but within 20 blocks it spits: one chance in seven starts an eight-round burst of Acid, one round per cadence tick from 1.5 blocks ahead of it with a clatter (SpitBugAcidAttackGoal.java:54-93); the synched DATA_ATTACKING int (:45-46) is held at 1 in reach and while a burst streams (BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:168; SpitBugAcidAttackGoal.java:60). It hops forward and up when it jumps (:145-156), takes one hit per 15 ticks and ignores falls and cactus (:177-202). It spawns in the dark, by day only on a 2-in-20 roll, with clear air about it (:305-313; ModEntities.java:292-294). Read it as a heavy beetle: four legs scuttling with a lift, the upper jaw twitching at rest and chomping fast when it fights, a spit from the mouth.
size_notes: Drawn at x0.75 of the rig (SpitBugRenderer.java:25, :38; shadow 0.4125, :27) on a 512x256 sheet (SpitBugModel.java:681), spitbug.png (SpitBugRenderer.java:20); the hitbox is 2.0 x 2.0 (ModEntities.java:292-294). The original's ModelSpitBug(0.55f) argument was the wingspeed (SpitBugModel.java:21), not a scale. Each leg is a position chain the code re-places each tick (14 px to the femur, 14 to the tibia, 8 to the tarsus; :813-943) - key the joints, not the positions.

groups.name: gait
groups.amplitude: sweep: pi x 0.12 = 0.377 rad (22 deg) x the walking speed as a sine, every piece of a leg yawing together about the root's rest (-1.2 right front, 1.2 left front, -2.1 left rear, 2.1 right rear); lift: |cos| x pi x 0.12 x the speed on the rising half of the sine only, added to the femur plates' pitches (-1.152 / -0.743 / -0.632 / -1.041) and subtracted from the tibia's (0.669) and the tarsus plates' (-0.48); the left front takes the sine, the left rear its negative, the right pair the same at half a cycle's offset; the femur is placed 14 px along the root, the tibia 14 along the femur, the tarsus 8 along the tibia; no threshold
groups.plain: the four legs sweep about the vertical in two opposed pairs and each leg lifts at the knee as it swings forward, the whole leg placed link by link
groups.math: s = sin(t * 2.0 * 0.55) * pi * 0.12 * amount; up = (sin at t + 0.1 > s) ? |cos(t * 2.0 * 0.55) * pi * 0.12 * amount| : 0; leftFront(s, up); leftRear(-s, up); s' = sin(t * 2.0 * 0.55 + pi) * pi * 0.12 * amount (up' likewise); rightFront(-s', up'); rightRear(s', up'); per leg: root and every piece yRot = rest + angle; femur plates xRot = rest + up; tibia xRot = 0.669 - up; tarsus xRot = -0.48 - up; positions chained by cos / sin of the yaw x 14, 14, 8
groups.source: SpitBugModel.java:691-706 (the phases), :813-943 (the four leg helpers); wingspeed 0.55 (:21)
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 2.0 x 0.55 = 1.1: the natural period is 5.71 ticks

groups.name: jaw
groups.amplitude: calm: |cos| x pi x 0.015 = up to 0.047 rad (2.7 deg) at 0.3 x 0.55 = 0.165 rad/tick; attacking: |cos| x pi x 0.1 = up to 0.314 rad (18 deg) at 2.6 x 0.55 = 1.43 rad/tick; one-sided (the absolute value), the three teeth about a 0.26 rad rest
groups.plain: the upper jaw plates and front teeth lift and drop: a tiny slow twitch at rest, a fast wide chomp while the attacking flag is up
groups.math: j = |attacking ? cos(t * 2.6 * 0.55) * pi * 0.1 : cos(t * 0.3 * 0.55) * pi * 0.015|; upperjawbasepart1..3.xRot = j; tooth1..3.xRot = 0.26 + j
groups.phase: the synched DATA_ATTACKING int (EntitySpitBug.java:45-46; held at 1 within reach, BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:168, and while an acid burst streams, SpitBugAcidAttackGoal.java:60) selects the branch
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.3 x 0.55 calm (a 38-tick period, halved by the absolute value) and x 2.6 x 0.55 attacking (4.4 ticks)

behaviour: One gait rhythm with no threshold (SpitBugModel.java:691-706): a sine at 1.1 rad/tick (a 5.7-tick period) sweeps each leg's eight moving pieces 22 degrees x the walking speed about the root's splay, the left front and left rear in opposition and the right pair the same half a cycle later; on the rising half of the sine a |cos| lift of the same size bends the femur plates up and the tibia and tarsus down - the step. Every leg is placed link by link along its yaw (14, 14 and 8 px; :813-943).

One branch on the synched DATA_ATTACKING int (EntitySpitBug.java:45-46), held at 1 while it stands within 3 blocks plus half the target's width (BugMeleeAttackGoal.java:168) or while an acid burst streams (SpitBugAcidAttackGoal.java:60) and dropped otherwise (:132, :145, :176): the three upper jaw plates and front teeth lift 2.7 degrees on a slow one-sided wave at rest and chomp 18 degrees at 1.43 rad/tick while it is up (:707-713).

The hip hub, the three coxa pieces of each leg, the fifteen abdomen plates, the upper jaw base, teeth 4 and 5, the twelve lower jaw plates, both palps and the eyes are static; there is no head bone and no look. The bite (doHurtTarget, EntitySpitBug.java:158-175), the acid rounds (SpitBugAcidAttackGoal.java:66-93) and the hop (EntitySpitBug.java:145-156) are not animation events.
